title: 無菌の塵と、微かな呼吸の残滓
author: 灰原 ユキト

en.title: Sterile Dust and the Faint Remnants of Breath
en.premise: In a world where every citizen's emotions and biological rhythms are monitored by the 'Resonance Management System,' any deviation is met with immediate 'adjustment.' Ellis, an archivist, spends her days in a curated silence, digitizing and erasing the final wills of the dead. But one day, hidden within data marked for deletion, she finds a phrase: 'Desert Oasis'—a reference to the once-lush surface of the earth. It is the sole clue to a realm beyond the system's control, a secret the administration has fought to keep buried.

zh.title: 无菌之尘与微弱的呼吸残迹
zh.premise: 全市民的情感与生物节律均被“共鸣管理系统”严密监控，任何偏差都将立即被“调整”。记录官艾莉丝在被管控的死寂之中，负责将死者的遗言数字化并彻底抹除。然而某日，在预定废弃的数据中，她偶然发现了一个词汇——“沙漠绿洲”，那是关于曾经绿意盎然的地表的记载。而这，竟是揭开系统长期隐瞒的、处于管理之外的生存区域的唯一线索。
